data.body:
Merged: Gerrit 3460 patch set 3 (ff9863ee24a), landed as 9a6ed3751128b697d2d7fe8fcbad0b4aa8877621 on origin/main with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 and 0 unresolved comments. make verify passed on that patch set (21,506 + 226 passed). It implements the revised operator rule: signer-not-on-keyring is its own verdict, not bad-signature, and it fails enforcement like key_not_valid_at_era.

Merged-build evidence (2026-11-19 PST): enforced `verify-identity --all`, no enforce_since, merged build 9a6ed375112 (cli-main worktree), on a fresh no-remote clone of the original tickets history at b878d77e28d:
`43518 verified, 874 unsigned, 0 unknown-author, 0 bad-signature, 0 key-not-valid-at-era, 6101 signer-not-on-keyring (50493 event(s) in scope)`. Exit 1: 6,975 enforced events are not verified (6,101 + 874).
- The 6,101 signer-not-on-keyring verdicts all carry display `unverified` and come from 2 keys, SHA256:biqEFL9T969c… (3,344) and SHA256:YWib9Gj1qZ+x… (2,757), the MCP box's op-cert keys. That cause is filed as promising-unwasteful-xantus (discovered_from this ticket); no keyring or deployment change was made.
- The 906 class-B null-signer entries now verify (42,612 + 906 = 43,518).
- The 874 unsigned events are out of scope.
The rewritten shadow history was not run with this build; it now belongs to another session.

Portability: verification logic only. No new subprocess, fd, path, encoding or permission handling, so no Windows sweep.
